description: This file provides a utility function 'formatLabel' that transforms object keys, typically in snake_case or underscored format, into a human-readable form with title casing and special handling for common acronyms. It is intended for display purposes in a front-end dashboard.

methods.name: formatLabel(key)
methods.description: Converts a snake_case or underscored label into Title Case with spaces, transforming common acronyms into uppercase variants for display.
